causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Over a series of rebids Origin and Snowy Hydro progressively shifted a total of around 3000 MW of capacity for generators in southern New South Wales to the price floor, thereby increasing their output. By 2.20 pm generation in southern New South Wales had increased to a level that caused the constraint to bind.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: Origin and Snowy Hydro also rebid their ramp down rates to the minimum allowable under the Rules which prolonged the period for which the constraint was binding.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The Terranora and Directlink interconnectors, which link New South Wales and Queensland, were flowing into New South Wales at their forecast limits. Consequently, additional low priced capacity from Queensland was inaccessible. ... flows across the Vic - NSW interconnector went from 780 MW into New South Wales at 2.25 pm to 90 MW counter price into Victoria at 3 pm.

constraints_named.quote: At 2.20 pm the system normal constraint, N>>N-NIL_01N, bound.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: flows across the Vic - NSW interconnector went from 780 MW into New South Wales at 2.25 pm to 90 MW counter price into Victoria at 3 pm.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: Imports across QNI and the Terranora interconnector were less than 330 MW for the duration of the high prices.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora
